text:
Maya Patel: DeployBot is blocking RC-42 canary in eu-west due to missing SBOM signature evidence. Anyone available to weigh in?

Sam Chen: seeing the same. DeployBot log: `SBOM_VERIFY: missing signature for image redwood/rc-42:canary-eu`

deploy-bot: (automated) release RC-42 canary deployment blocked in eu-west at 1745010000 due to SBOM signature verification failure.

Leo Ortiz: Is this the signing step that flaked in the artifact pipeline or a provenance mismatch from the builder?

Sam Chen: Looks like cosign attach failed intermittently during yesterday's publish job. I can fetch the artifact metadata. Give me 10m.

Tess Rivera: If signing is delayed we need to choose: (A) pin the digest and allow region-limited canary with strict monitoring, or (B) rollback the canary until signature verifies. Legal/security ok with pinned-carveout?

security-review-bot: (automated) Policy: unsigned SBOMs require explicit reviewer approval for regional carveouts. Suggested approvers: @Maya Patel, @Leo Ortiz, security-oncall.

Maya Patel: I can approve a timeboxed EU carveout if we add a rollback trigger and collect evidence now. Conditions: 1) pin to digest `sha256:8a7f...c3b9` 2) rollback if error rate >1% OR 5m consecutive failing health checks 3) attach artifact provenance link to the release notes.

Sam Chen: I pulled the metadata: `cosign verify -a sbom.json redwood/rc-42@sha256:8a7f...c3b9` returns "not found" — signing didn't get attached. But the image exists. I can re-run signing today.

Leo Ortiz: Operationally fine with pinned digest for eu-west only. We should also restrict traffic to 5% of normal canary load and enable kv-cache warmup off so we can measure cold-start regressions.

Tess Rivera: I'll draft the short approval statement for audit and add the artifact link. Will need @Maya Patel thumbs-up in thread. Change window requested: next 30m.

Maya Patel: +1 to timeboxed carveout under the listed conditions. Approving for eu-west canary only, 30m window starting at 1745010120. Must include link to signed-evidence once available.

deploy-bot: (automated) action: carveout-allow region=eu-west, digest=sha256:8a7f...c3b9, max-traffic=5%, rollback-triggers=[error_rate>1%, health_fail_5m]. Window start=1745010120, window_end=1745011920.

Sam Chen: Doing manual cosign attach now then I'll post the proof link: `gs://artifacts/redwood/rc-42/sha256-8a7f...c3b9/sbom-cosigned.json` once complete.

Leo Ortiz: I'll watch the canary dashboards. If latency or error spikes, I'll kick the rollback.

Tess Rivera: Added a short note to release notes: "EU canary allowed temporarily with pinned digest due to signing delay; full rollout gated on SBOM verification." Will add audit id after Sam posts link.

Sam Chen: Uploaded proof: https://storage.internal.redwood/artifacts/rc-42/sha256-8a7f...c3b9/sbom-cosigned.json (cosign verification hash included).

Maya Patel: Received. Closing approval loop. Keep me posted in thread if rollback triggers.

Leo Ortiz: All good — monitoring green so far.

deploy-bot: (automated) note: will auto-rollback if triggers hit; operators may also manually abort with `/deploybot abort rc-42 eu-west`.
